title: I Printed the Group-Chat Poll After They Voted Me the Driver Again

parts.text: I opened the trip poll at 8:08 p.m. and the options were me driving or me driving with snacks. I have driven the last five weekends. I was twenty-five, the only one with a car that starts. I screenshotted the poll, the last five gas Venmos that never filled, and my calendar. Then I added a third option: bus schedule plus split Uber. At 8:16 they named the third option a vibe kill and locked the poll with me still winning.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: They locked a two-option poll with my car as both choices.

social.video_title: Poll options: me driving, or me driving with snacks — Part 1/2
social.description: Five weekends, unpaid gas, a locked vibe. Would you have added the bus anyway?

parts.text: I sent the bus PDF and muted the chat until Monday. They Uber'd and discovered numbers. I met them there as a passenger once, on my terms. The car started for grocery runs, not for unpaid tours. Vibe kill is a budget. Polls need real options. I un-muted. Someone else created the next poll with four choices. I did not win. I brought snacks for myself. The engine rested like it had a union.

social.description: Passenger once, grocery car, four-choice poll. Was a vibe a chauffeur?
